outline:
GREEN TECHNOLOGY is a basic course taught completely in English, mainly for the students who have not studied Environmental Sciences as a subject. The course will cover topics related to Environmental processes and techniques that reduce the negative environmental impacts like pollution and protect our planet. Students can gain introductory knowledge about green and sustainable methods of producing energy and thereby preventing hazardous environmental issues through significant energy efficiency improvements and sustainable use of resources.
Week 1: Green Technology- Introduction and Basics
Week 2: Green  Energy Sources
Week 3: Carbon Cycle
Week 4: Carbon Footprint
Week 5: Carbon Trading
Week 6: Carbon Sequestration
Week 7: Geoengineering
Week 8: Bio energy
Week 9: Midterm Exam
Week 10: Sustainable Resource Management (SRM)
Week 11: Sustainable Biofuels
Week 12: Sustainable Hydrogen fuel cells
Week 13: Sustainable Biological fuel cells
Week 14: Sustainable Agriculture
Week 15: Sustainable Conversion Technologies
Week 16: Sustainable Remediation
Week 17: Sustainable Tourism
Week 18: Final Exam
schedule:
1.	The students will be separated into groups
2.	In each class the Teacher will first teach a PowerPoint presentation
3.	This will be followed by the presentations of the students in each group
4.	The students can use Powerpoint and YouTube videos to make their presentations interesting
assessment:
1.	The Teacher will conduct 2 exams during the course (Midterm and Final) for 50 marks
2.	The final score will be for 100% and it will be a sum of evaluations as 50% (from the final written exam) 25% (from the Midterm exam score) 15% (from the class presentations) 10% (from class attendance and attentiveness).
